blind.description: A classic brass balance scale consisting of a square reddish-brown wooden plinth base, a central turned brass pillar, a horizontal crossbeam, and two suspended brass pans hanging from curved wire handles. All surfaces are clean, smooth, solid, and continuous with no floating or broken parts.
blind.from_above: Seen directly from above, it shows a straight horizontal brass bar with two circular shallow bowls on either side, over a square brown base, casting a distinct silhouette shadow of the balance beam and hanging pans.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/6 the height of the figure (around 10-12 inches tall) and about 1 foot wide across the balance beam.
